intro.line: Ixalan, a plane of jungle and sea. Four peoples are racing for a golden city, and the sun at its heart.
The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.
The River Heralds would wreck a thousand ships to keep intruders from finding the golden city.
Jace Beleren has lost his memory. He sails with a pirate captain named Vraska, who has not told him everything.

finale.line: As the struggle raged for control of the Immortal Sun, the world grew dark under a blood-red sky.
Jace and Vraska trap Azor on a desert island, away from the Sun. Azor thought he was being kind.
Jace remembers who he is. Vraska remembers who she works for, and says nothing.

villainFinale.line: The Immortal Sun burns on, gold and hollow, and Azor keeps it.

battles.title: The Search for the Golden City
battles.blurb: You wake on Ixalan with Jace and Vraska. Search the jungle for the way to Orazca. The Legion of Dusk is searching too.

cards.name: Legion's Landing // Adanto, the First Fort

scene.line: For the first time in her life, Vraska tried to prevent death.
No lock of iron is a match for Vraska's will of stone.
Explore: look at the top card of your library. A land goes to your hand. Anything else, and the creature grows and you choose whether to keep the card.

villainScene.line: I claim this land in the name of the queen.
The Legion of Dusk sailed from Torrezon in search of glory, riches, and the Immortal Sun.

battles.title: Plunder and Dance
battles.blurb: Admiral Beckett Brass and the Brazen Coalition sail up the Great River. The River Heralds are waiting.

scene.line: You and your ship will make a fine addition to my fleet.
We sail. We plunder. Then we dance.
Treasure: a token that sacrifices for one mana of any colour. Sail fast, spend it on the turn that matters.

villainScene.line: The River Heralds would wreck a thousand ships to keep intruders from finding the golden city.
The same power that drives the river ever onward flows through the roots and branches—to me.

hero.half: Spend Treasure for a bigger turn.

battles.title: Huatli and the Raptors
battles.blurb: Huatli, a warrior poet of the Sun Empire, rides her dinosaurs against pirates who have come ashore. Every dinosaur takes a hit and keeps coming.

scene.line: Run like the wind, fierce one. The hunt has begun.
Every little hatchling has a parent's claws to guard it.
Enrage: it triggers whenever the creature is dealt damage. Let your dinosaur take the hit and watch what happens.

villainScene.line: Keep your friends close and your enemies within range.
Disputes within the Brazen Coalition can escalate from insult to broadside in the blink of an eye.

hero.half: Let your dinosaurs take the damage.

battles.title: Vona of Iedo
battles.blurb: Jace, with no memory, learns that Vona of Iedo has led armies of conquest for four hundred years. She wants the golden city, and so do you.

scene.line: Jace awoke to the certainty that he was lost.
Clearly, it indicates the aetheric azimuth of . . .
Lifelink: damage it deals gains its controller that much life. Race a lifelinker and your damage has to outrun theirs.

villainScene.line: For four hundred years, I have led armies of conquest. These lands hold nothing that can stand against me.
Cut the beasts out from under them and their strength is nothing.

battles.title: The City's Blessing
battles.blurb: Kumena knows the only way to keep his enemies from Orazca is to claim its power himself. Tishana, the Voice of Thunder, stands against him.

cards.name: Hadana's Climb // Winged Temple of Orazca

scene.line: The truth came to Kumena like the Great River's torrent: the only way to keep his enemies away from the hidden city was to claim its power for himself.
A fool's fire is quickly quenched.
Ascend: control ten permanents and you get the city's blessing for the rest of the game. Build a wide board, then enjoy the bonus.

battles.title: Dinosaurs
battles.blurb: A tribute to the tribes of Ixalan Standard: Gruul Dinosaurs against Vampires. Big beasts against the Legion of Dusk.

scene.line: Carnivorous dinosaurs developed a taste for undead flesh, tracking the vampires by the scent of blood on their breath.
Sun Empire commanders are well versed in advanced martial strategy. Still, the correct maneuver is usually to deploy the giant, implacable death lizard.
Dinosaurs hit harder than vampires. Fight them early and fast, before the lifelinkers stabilise.

villainScene.line: Vampires, the noble class of old Torrezon, are guided by their dual loyalties to church and crown.
By the law of church and crown, vampires feed only on the blood of the guilty—those declared heretics, rebels, or enemies of war.

battles.title: Pirates
battles.blurb: A tribute to the tribes of Ixalan Standard: Pirate aggro against the Merfolk of the Great River.

scene.line: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition are the descendants of those displaced by the Legion of Dusk, and they are eager for vengeance.
Without frequent raids, orcs sometimes get bored and plunder their own ships.
Pirates are fast and fragile. Hit first and keep the pressure on.

villainScene.line: The River Heralds fight to keep all others from reaching the golden city. The city has its own defenses.
With matchless stealth, the River Heralds fought a running battle against the three enemy forces.

battles.title: The Lawbringer
battles.blurb: Azor built the Immortal Sun and thinks he is keeping the plane safe. Jace and Vraska have to take it away from him.

scene.line: Opening Orazca unleashed more horrors than just the Immortal Sun.
Carefully following the thaumatic compass Bolas had given her, Vraska blundered straight into the River Heralds' trap.
We cannot beat the Sun by force. Break his hold on it before the walkers are trapped.

villainScene.line: The Immortal Sun will bring us true eternal life to replace the everlasting shadow of undeath.

hero.half: Do not let him keep the Sun.

battles.title: Rekindling Phoenix
battles.blurb: Deep in the archive, a flier that will not stay dead.

archive.what: Red and black decks built around Rekindling Phoenix, a four-mana flier that came back from the graveyard if you did not deal with the 0/1 it left behind.
archive.why: The Phoenix was a bomb: a threat that was hard to answer for good, in a format full of aggro and midrange.
archive.beat: Exile it or kill the Elemental token on their upkeep before it can return the Phoenix.
archive.after: Ixalan and Rivals of Ixalan rotated out of Standard in autumn 2019.

deck.name: Rekindling Phoenix
deck.label: tribute
deck.note: Built from cards in this act's sets only. No single tournament list is copied.

scene.line: If you come across a raptor in the city, stay perfectly still. At least then you'll be well rested when you die.
Kill the Elemental token before their upkeep, or the Phoenix comes back.

villainScene.line: Captain Angrath cares less about treasure than mayhem. If he can't leave Ixalan, he'll burn the plane down.

after.line: Recorded: Ixalan block rotated out of Standard in autumn 2019.

hero.half: Kill the token on their upkeep.
